A thin, crisp tart with fresh pears.

Peel the pears and slice them thinly.
Arrange them on the pastry, sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon, and dot with butter.
The thick Breton custard cake with prunes, golden and soft.

Mix the flour, the sugar and a pinch of salt, then add the eggs one by one.
Pour in the milk little by little, whisking.

Blend them until they have an ice cream texture.
